subject.title: fix(acp): use Object.hasOwn instead of in operator in printSessionUpdate

question: Should maintainers grant a narrow real-behavior-proof override for this defensive ACP discriminator guard, or require real `openclaw acp client` output before merge?
rationale: The source change is narrow and dependency-backed, but ClawSweeper cannot clear an external contributor PR's real behavior proof gate from unit tests and synthetic output alone.

options.title: Grant narrow proof override
options.body: Accept the SDK discriminator contract plus focused regression tests for this prototype-chain-only cleanup and let the PR proceed after exact-head review.

options.title: Require ACP runtime proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a recording from an actual ACP client session on the current head before merge.

recommendation.title: Grant narrow proof override
recommendation.body: Accept the SDK discriminator contract plus focused regression tests for this prototype-chain-only cleanup and let the PR proceed after exact-head review.
